       "[N+]6(=C7C(=[N+]8(c9cc(C(C)(C)C)cc(C(C)(C)C)c9O2))C=CC=C7)"
       "c%10cc(C(C)(C)C)cc(C(C)(C)C)c%10O1")

    print("charge:", Chem.GetFormalCharge(mol))
    params = AllChem.ETKDGv3()
    params.randomSeed = 42
    cid = AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol, params)
    print("embed:", cid)
    if cid >= 0:
        AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mol, maxIters=500) if AllChem.MMFFHasAllMoleculeParams(mol) else None

from rdkit import Chem

# ring closures: 1=Sb-N1, 2=Sb-O1, 3=Sb-N2, 4=Sb-O2, 8=central quinoid ring, 10=ring A, 11=ring B
smi = ("[Sb-2]%1%2%3%4(c5ccccc5)(c6ccccc6)(c7ccccc7)"
       "([N+]1(=C8C(=N+3(c%11cc(C(C)(C)C)cc(C(C)(C)C)c%11O%4))C=CC=C8)"
       "c%10cc(C(C)(C)C)cc(C(C)(C)C)c%10O%2)")
mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
print("sanitized mol:", mol is not None)
if mol is None:
    mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi, sanitize=False)
    print("unsanitized parse:", mol is not None)
    if mol is not None:
        flags = Chem.SanitizeFlags.SANITIZE_ALL ^ Chem.SanitizeFlags.SANITIZE_PROPERTIES
        Chem.SanitizeMol(mol, flags)
        print("partial sanitize ok")
if mol is not None:
    mol = Chem.AddHs(mol)
    from rdkit.Chem import rdMolDescriptors
    print("formula:", rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(mol))
    print("formal charge:", Chem.GetFormalCharge(mol))
    params = AllChem.ETKDGv3()
    params.randomSeed = 42
    cid = AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol, params)
    print("embed:", cid)
    if cid >= 0:
        ok = AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(mol, maxIters=2000)
        print("uff:", ok)
        Chem.MolToXYZFile(mol, "initial.xyz")

content: RDKit's SMILES parser rejects hypervalent Sb. I'll build the molecular graph programmatically atom-by-atom instead:

args.command:
cat > build2.py << 'EOF'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdMolDescriptors
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D

B = Chem.BondType
mol = Chem.RWMol()
idx = {}
def add(sym, charge=0, name=None):
    a = Chem.Atom(sym); a.SetFormalCharge(charge); a.SetNoImplicit(False)
    i = mol.AddAtom(a); return i

# 0 Sb
Sb = add("Sb", -2); mol.GetAtomWithIdx(Sb).SetNoImplicit(True)
# phenyls on Sb: 1-6, 7-12, 13-18
phs = []
for k in range(3):
    base = 1 + 6*k
    ids = [add("C") for _ in range(6)]
    phs.append(ids)
# ligand
N1 = add("N", +1)          # 19
A = [add("C") for _ in range(6)]   # 20-25? careful ordering below
# Let's lay out explicitly instead:
# ring A: C1..C6
rA = A
O1 = add("O")              # 26
tA1 = [add("C") for _ in range(4)] # 27-30 (quaternary + 3 Me)
tA2 = [add("C") for _ in range(4)] # 31-34
N2 = add("N", +1)          # 35
Cg, Ch = add("C"), add("C")        # 36, 37
Cc = [add("C") for _ in range(4)]  # 38-41 central CHs
rB = [add("C") for _ in range(6)]  # 42-47 ring B
O2 = add("O")              # 48
tB1 = [add("C") for _ in range(4)] # 49-52
tB2 = [add("C") for _ in range(4)] # 53-56

def bond(i, j, order=B.SINGLE):
    mol.AddBond(i, j, order)

# Sb bonds
for p in phs: bond(Sb, p[0])
bond(Sb, N1); bond(Sb, N2); bond(Sb, O1); bond(Sb, O2)
# phenyl rings kekule
for p in phs:
    for i in range(6):
        o = B.DOUBLE if i % 2 == 0 else B.SINGLE
        bond(p[i], p[(i+1) % 6], o)
# ring A: rA[0]=C1(N1), rA[1]=C2(O1), rA[2]=C3(tBu), rA[3]=C4H, rA[4]=C5(tBu), rA[5]=C6H
bond(N1, rA[0]); bond(rA[1], O1); bond(rA[2], tA1[0]); bond(rA[4], tA2[0])
bond(rA[0], rA[1], B.DOUBLE); bond(rA[1], rA[2]); bond(rA[2], rA[3], B.DOUBLE)
bond(rA[3], rA[4]); bond(rA[4], rA[5], B.DOUBLE); bond(rA[5], rA[0])
# ring B: rB[0]=C1(N2), rB[1]=C2(O2), rB[2]=C3(tBu), rB[3]=C4H, rB[4]=C5(tBu), rB[5]=C6H
bond(N2, rB[0]); bond(rB[1], O2); bond(rB[2], tB1[0]); bond(rB[4], tB2[0])
bond(rB[0], rB[1], B.DOUBLE); bond(rB[1], rB[2]); bond(rB[2], rB[3], B.DOUBLE)
bond(rB[3], rB[4]); bond(rB[4], rB[5], B.DOUBLE); bond(rB[5], rB[0])
# central quinoid ring: Cg(=N2), Ch(=N1), then CHs Cc0..Cc3
bond(N2, Cg, B.DOUBLE); bond(N1, Ch, B.DOUBLE)
bond(Cg, Ch); bond(Ch, Cc[0]); bond(Cc[0], Cc[1], B.DOUBLE)
bond(Cc[1], Cc[2]); bond(Cc[2], Cc[3], B.DOUBLE); bond(Cc[3], Cg)
# tBu
for t in (tA1, tA2, tB1, tB2):
    for m in t[1:]: bond(t[0], m)

m = mol.GetMol()
m.UpdatePropertyCache(strict=False)
Chem.SanitizeMol(m, Chem.SanitizeFlags.SANITIZE_ALL ^ Chem.SanitizeFlags.SANITIZE_PROPERTIES)
print("heavy atoms:", m.GetNumAtoms())
print("formula:", rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
print("charge:", Chem.GetFormalCharge(m))
sb = m.GetAtomWithIdx(Sb); print("Sb bonds:", len(sb.GetBonds()))
mH = Chem.AddHs(m)
print("with H:", mH.GetNumAtoms())
p = AllChem.ETKDGv3(); p.randomSeed = 7
cid = AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mH, p)

**Summary of what was built:**
- **Molecule depicted:** a seven-coordinate antimony(2−) complex — Sb bears three phenyl groups plus a tetradentate N₂O₂ bis(iminoquinone)-type ligand: two N⁺ imine nitrogens (each =C to an o-quinoid central benzene ring and bonded to a 3,5-di-tert-butylphenyl ring) and two phenolate O⁻ donors (Sb–O), giving four tert-butyl groups total.
